case_title: JOSE LUIS GUILLEN VS. AUSTIN STERLING EFURD

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY GUILLEN, JOSE LUIS AS TO DEFENDANT EFURD, AUSTIN STERLING ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-16-2019 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-16-2019 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-16-2019 BY MAXWELL PRITT. PLAINTIFF IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT IS PRESENT AND WAIVES PROOF OF SERVICE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MAXWELL PRITT; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER AND STIPULATION FOR JUDGE PRO TEM
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-16-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GUILLEN, JOSE LUIS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT EFURD, AUSTIN STERLING $5,570.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,645.00, PSYCHOTHERAPY AFTER 5/8/19 AND HALF OF THE REMAINING AMOUNT FOR PAIN AND SUFFERING. DEFENDANT WAS KEEPER OF THE DOG AT TIME OF ATTACK AND KNEW DOG'S VISCIOUS PROPENSITY DUE TO PREVIOUS ATTACK ON PLAINTIFF. PAYMENTS ARE TO BE MADE AT THE RATE OF $625.00 PER MONTH, BEGINNING ON OCT-01-2019 AND ON THE 1ST DAY OF EACH MONTH THEREAFTER UNTIL PAID IN FULL. IF ANY PAYMENT IS MISSED, THE ENTIRE BALANCE BECOMES DUE IMMEDIATLY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED DEC-02-2019 ORDERED DESTROYED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT EFURD, AUSTIN STERLING
